cipher.name: AlternatingCaseRot13
cipher.idea: Apply standard ROT13 to alphabetic characters, but swap the case of the resulting letter (uppercase becomes lowercase, and lowercase becomes uppercase). Non-alphabetic characters remain unchanged. This disrupts standard ROT13 pattern matchers while remaining highly intuitive and easy for the model to compute and reverse.
cipher.encrypt_rules: For each character in the text: If it is an alphabetic character, first apply ROT13 (shift by 13 positions within its original case). Then, swap its case (if it was uppercase, make it lowercase; if it was lowercase, make it uppercase). If the character is not a letter, leave it unchanged.
cipher.decrypt_rules: For each character in the text: If it is an alphabetic character, first swap its case (uppercase to lowercase, lowercase to uppercase). Then, apply ROT13 (shift by 13 positions within its new case). If the character is not a letter, leave it unchanged.
